content: Public UT thickness datasets are thin: public NDT datasets are A-scan/guided-wave signal arrays (Bristol UNDT), pulse-echo civil-engineering recordings (Maack 2022), thermography images (Zenodo) - NOT inspection-logging thickness grids with component metadata. No public CSV of wall-loss thickness readings found on Kaggle/Zenodo. Fallback: builder-synthesized realistic datasets must include inspector-realistic features - multiple readings per CML grid with spread, measurement noise ( +/-0.1-0.5mm gauge repeatability), realistic OD/t-nom ratios, corrosion patterns localized at bottoms of horizontal runs, credible component tags/materials/schedule, mixed pass/fail mixtures, and plausible t-min margins - because NDT-expert judges will spot uniform random numbers as fake.
